news.headline: Quiq Voice AI is now available in the Zoom App Marketplace with integration into Zoom Contact Center
news.summary: Quiq, the agentic AI platform for enterprise customer experience, today announced its integration with Zoom Contact Center.. Enterprises using Zoom Contact Center can now add Quiq's Voice AI agent to help handle repetitive calls and reduce call volume to contact center agents. Quiq's Voice AI also escalates smoothly to human agents with the call details and full context delivered right in the Zoom desktop app.
